steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Beat together egg, water, salt, and pepper in a shallow bowl. Set 2 tablespoons bread crumbs aside; pour remaining bread crumbs into a large resealable plastic bag.
Dip chicken in egg mixture, then place in the plastic bag and shake to coat with bread crumbs.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook coated chicken in hot oil until browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Remove chicken from the skillet.
Add remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil to the skillet; cook and stir zucchini and garlic over medium heat until zucchini is slightly tender, about 2 minutes. Transfer to the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons reserved bread crumbs over zucchini. Top with tomato slices, 2/3 cup mozzarella cheese, and basil. Arrange chicken on top. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil.

Bake in the preheated oven until chicken is no longer pink in the center and juices run clear, about 25 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Uncover and sprinkle with remaining 1/3 cup mozzarella cheese. Bake until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Baked Chicken and Zucchini
raw_recipe.description: This chicken and zucchini recipe features baked chicken breasts, squash, tomatoes, and fresh basil for a colorful dish ready in less than an hour.

video.description: Watch how to bake up a delicious casserole with breaded and seared chicken, sauteed zucchini, tomatoes, and cheese. There are a few steps to assembling this dish before it goes into the oven, but each one adds a layer of flavor and texture. Enjoy this for dinner with a salad on a side and perhaps a slice of garlic bread.

review.reviewBody: We loved this (even my veggie-finnickey husband) but I only gave it 4 stars because I believe without the additions I made it wouldn't have been the 5 star dish it turned out to be. I diced up 1 medium onion and 1 red bell pepper and sauteed those with the zucchini and garlic. After sauteing, I added them to the greased dish where I placed a half jar of marinated artichoke hearts in a sparse layer on top (I will use the whole jar next time..they were tasty!). I followed the recipe to a "t" other than that and it turned out great! It really creates its own side, and with all the veggies and the use of olive oil (and I used lite salt) it made for a healthy AND delicious meal!

Delicious! I made this all in a cast iron pan. Sautéed some red onion before adding zucchini and garlic. Cooked the zucchini much longer than 2 minutes. Used a can of fire roasted tomatoes in place of fresh. Served with a side of cauliflower risotto. Looked beautiful too!

This meal is SOOOO delicious! It really deserves at least ten stars and it is most definitely going to be made frequently around here. Even our four Afghans teenage refugees, INHALED this. My husband remarked, "I've never had fish that tastes like this." I replied, "That's because it is chicken." Grin. But he made the comment because the meat was so tender and juicy. I am an American woman living in a small town (population 6000) in Sweden with my Swedish husband. This means that I have to "do it myself' when it comes to seasoned bread crumbs. Last evening I used Panko bread crumbs and blended them with garlic powder, rosemary, oregano and a generous amount of sage and I also used boneless, skinless chicken thighs because that it what I had. Plus, because my youths were "desperately" hungry and clamoring for dinner, I shortened the preparations by omitting the egg wash and shaking the individual chicken pieces in the bread crumbs. Instead I shook approximately half of the bread crumbs over the tomato layer and used more mozzarella than called for (personal preference) and then shook the rest of the bread crumbs over the chicken before covering it with another generous helping of mozzarella. As I said, this meal was pure delight. "Sadly" there were no left-overs!!

This was simple to make and very delicious! My husband absolutely loved it and raved about it. The only changes I made were to add some sweet peppers and red onions to the zucchini and garlic mix. I also added a little bit of lemon juice, soy sauce and salt and pepper to the vegetables for more flavour, and sprinkled them with Parmesan cheese before adding the chicken and baking. Oh, and I sliced the chicken into chicken tenders instead of using whole breasts. I served it over spaghettini noodles. Thank you for sharing this recipe, it's definitely a keeper!

This was delicious! The only thing extra that I added was Parmesan cheese for added flavor in with the chicken & vegetables. I also used a can of stewed tomatoes as that is what I had on hand. I put all the Mozzarella cheese on in the last 10 minutes of baking. Superb!

This recipe is awesome! My husband kept saying over and over as he ate that he loved it! I made using a can of fire roasted tomatoes to replace fresh, cut up a red and a yellow bell pepper and small white onion. I sauteed these before the zucchini was sauteed. I also added more mozza, enough to cover all. Thanks for the recipe!! Yum!

Great recipe. Grandchildren and my husband loved it! I did add sliced peppers and onions to the veggies. Have also taken it out of oven when done, spooned some jarred pasta sauce over chicken then added reserved mozzarella cheese. This version got rave reviews from the family.

Love this! Only change made was in seasonings. I seasoned flour with a garlic sea salt blend along with some red pepper. Dipped chicken in flour, egg and a Panko bread crumb mix. We love the vegetables so I always add extra. Served with a cauliflower rice.

This was great! I didn’t plan ahead for this, but was able to keep to the spirit of the recipe with items I had on hand.I used a bag of frozen spiral zucchini broken apart into chunks and added some chopped garlic on top. I sprinkled gluten free bread crumbs on top followed by a can of Italian spiced tomatoes. Then I added the shredded cheese (Provel- a St. Louis thing). I am limiting fried food, so I just put salt, pepper and garlic powder on 4 chicken thighs and placed them on top. Baked uncovered for 35 minutes and wow! One pan dish and tasted wonderful!

Check out my pics. I altered the recipe. Ditched the tomatoes...added bell peppers (yellow, red, & orange) and ginger to the recipe. Also, I sautéed the zucchini, peppers, garlic and fresh ginger for about 2 mins more than directed. I took the liberty of squeezing 1 fresh whole lemon on the organic and skinless chicken breasts. I also seasoned the chicken breasts to my liking before the egg wash and bread crumbs. I would recommend that. It was perfect. I think the chicken would have been bland without it. Elegant and delicious dish!

This was great. Thank you to all who gave tweaks. I did too, although I find the recipe itself fun and unique. I cut my zucchini quite thick, added red peppers and red onions, and did chicken strips. That allowed full cooking time for chicken but veggies were not at all "mushy" they were actually still crunchy. Served with jasmine rice and it was outstanding. My hubby said it was his favorite recipe yet.
As suggested by others, added bell peppers and artichoke hearts. Needed more salt. May add capers next time as well. Delicious.
I really like the vegetable base, makes it more healthy when you need to eat more veggies. I do wish it had more flavor, maybe needed more basil and that was my fault for not applying more.
Lovely dish to use summer produce. I made some rice pilaf as a side. Perfect.

Great recipe. I mix zucchini and summer squash cut in cubes. I put some oregano in with the basil. Romaine tomato’s. The rest all the same. I’m back watching my garden to make it again. Such a great recipe for summer with my garden.

Great recipe! Will make again and again. Only had 2 zucchinis so used yellow squash. Had a bunch of home grown tomatoes, so used more than 4. Didn't have any Mozzarella so used Provolone. Was delish!!!
replaced the tomato with 1 1/2 tablespoon of salsa for more intense flavor
Just made this, it's delicious. Thank you

This was a delicious recipe, especially for this time of fresh zucchini, tomatoes and basil! I used panko crumbs and I did season them with a little salt and paprika. I used drumsticks and they worked perfectly! One change I would suggest-use at least 3 Tablespoons or even 1/4 cup of fresh basil. I did this and it was so delicious! Thanks for the recipe!
Very Very nice the family said 👍 thanks
